translations.web: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.
translations.bsb: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
translations.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.
